scope: Mindelo and selected destinations across São Vicente.

records.name: Hospital Dr. Baptista de Sousa
records.description: Mindelo’s hospital campus for hospital-level care and services.
records.location: Largo do Tarrafal, Mindelo, São Vicente
records.caveat: Confirm the service you need and current access arrangements directly with the hospital.

records.name: Urgimed
records.description: A Mindelo clinic for non-hospital medical care and clinical services.
records.location: Rua Senegal, corner with Avenida Professor Alberto Leite, Mindelo
records.caveat: Confirm the service, clinician availability and opening arrangements before travelling.

records.name: Farmácia Jovem
records.description: A Mindelo pharmacy; provider evidence also supports an adult food-supplement offering.
records.location: Avenida 12 de Setembro, Mindelo, São Vicente
records.caveat: Do not assume a medicine or supplement is in stock. After-hours duty status rotates and is not a permanent attribute of this pharmacy.

records.name: Cesária Évora International Airport
records.description: São Vicente’s airport at São Pedro and the main arrival/departure point for air travel.
records.provider: Airport operator / Cabo Verde aviation information system
records.caveat: Airport ATM availability can change. Do not assume SIM sales or foreign-currency exchange are available at the airport.

records.name: Praça Estrela
records.description: A usual Mindelo orientation area for aluguers serving selected São Vicente destination corridors.
records.caveat: The mapped point represents the praça/boarding area at area-level precision, not an exact stand for a particular vehicle or destination.

records.name: Gare Marítima de Mindelo
records.description: Mindelo’s maritime terminal for inter-island ferry travel and related passenger services.
records.location: Avenida Marginal / Terminal de Cabotagem, Mindelo
records.caveat: The terminal identity and address are supported, but a canonical numeric coordinate has not yet been reconciled for this release. Location not pinned yet.

records.name: Casa do Cidadão — São Vicente
records.description: A São Vicente public-service branch for selected citizen and document services.
records.location: Mindelo, São Vicente — current exact pin not confirmed
records.provider: Casa do Cidadão / Ministry of Justice
records.caveat: Current branch operation is supported, but the exact 2026 street location has not been sufficiently reconfirmed. Location not pinned yet.

records.name: ELECTRA — São Vicente
records.description: The São Vicente utility/customer-service point for piped-water distribution, billing and service questions.
records.location: Rua / Avenida Dr. Baltazar Lopes da Silva, nº 10, Mindelo
records.caveat: This is a network-water utility/customer-service record, not a bottled-water refill, 20L bottle supplier or delivery depot. Location not pinned yet.

records.name: Lavandaria DnD — Vila Nova
records.description: Laundry service supporting washing, drying and ironing; provider-originated evidence also references collection/delivery.
records.location: Rua Jolly — Vila Nova / Cruz de Papa, Mindelo
records.caveat: Confirm current hours, prices and collection/delivery arrangements directly. Exact coordinates are not established; location not pinned yet.

records.name: Lavandaria DnD — Chã de Alecrim
records.description: A second DnD laundry branch supported at neighborhood level in Chã de Alecrim.
records.location: Chã de Alecrim, Mindelo — neighborhood-level precision only
records.caveat: The branch is supported at neighborhood level, not at a precise street/site. Confirm current arrangements directly; location not pinned yet.

records.name: Cleber Moreira Phone Dealer — Mindelo
records.description: Phones and accessories plus technical assistance including screen, battery, software and water-damage repair.
records.caveat: Confirm parts, brand support and same-day repair availability before travelling. Location not pinned yet.

records.name: Mercado de Peixe do Mindelo
records.description: The traditional/permanent Mindelo fish-market identity, retained while redevelopment and relocation remain in transition.
records.caveat: A PRASA has not confirmed that the temporary Praça Estrela market became operational. Do not treat Praça Estrela as the current fish-market location.

transit.aluguer_note: Ask at Praça Estrela for the vehicle to your destination. Aluguers commonly leave when sufficiently full rather than to a published timetable. Before travelling to an outlying settlement, ask where and roughly when to find the return service.
